name: link
description: Add a cross-link between two nodes in different branches, outside the tree. Use it when one idea supports, contradicts, depends on or is an example of another. Give a short label (e.g. contradicts, supports, depends on, example of) and a one-sentence reason. Do not link a node to its own parent or child; the tree already shows that.

from_id.description: Link source. Node id (nd_...) or an @ref you set earlier in this run.

to_id.description: Link target. Node id (nd_...) or an @ref you set earlier in this run.

label.description: Short relation, shown on the edge.
